title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is an evil of begging? (1 mark)
   A. Better skills
   B. Loss of dignity
   C. More friends
   D. Higher income

2. What is oral hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Cleaning the room
   B. Cleaning clothes
   C. Washing feet
   D. Keeping the mouth and teeth clean

3. Which of these shows love from parents? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Shouting all day
   C. Comparing children
   D. Listening and praising good behaviour

4. What is tayammum? (1 mark)
   A. A type of prayer
   B. Washing with soap
   C. Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   D. A dua

5. Which is an obligation of parents? (1 mark)
   A. Neglecting health
   B. Providing food, clothing and shelter
   C. Making them work all day
   D. Ignoring children

6. What is tuma'ninah? (1 mark)
   A. Calmness in each position
   B. Loudness
   C. Speed
   D. Ignoring order

7. How many verses does Surah An-Naas have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 5

8. Why should you tell a parent if something online makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. They will laugh
   C. They can protect you
   D. It wastes their time

9. Which prayer has two rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Dhuhr
   C. Asr
   D. Maghrib

10. Which name of Allah reminds us He hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Ar-Rahman
   C. Al-Malik
   D. As-Sami'

11. What does "Ar-Rahman" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King
   B. The All-Seeing
   C. The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   D. The All-Hearing

12. Which pillar of Iman are we practising when we say "I believe in the angels"? (1 mark)
   A. Belief in destiny
   B. Belief in the Last Day
   C. Belief in Allah's angels
   D. Belief in the books

13. Who is a "bibi"? (1 mark)
   A. Cousin
   B. Uncle
   C. Grandfather
   D. Grandmother

14. What is a good way to remember to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it to the weekend
   B. Only brush when a friend does
   C. Forget it
   D. Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall

15. Why did Allah create angels? (1 mark)
   A. To worship Him and carry out His orders
   B. To be worshipped
   C. To play
   D. To rule over people

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name. (3 marks)

17. Explain why keeping family ties is important. (4 marks)

18. Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong. (4 marks)

19. State two creatures of Allah in your environment. (2 marks)

20. Explain tartib in swalah. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Loss of dignity
   Begging lowers dignity.

2. D — Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   Oral means mouth.

3. D — Listening and praising good behaviour
   Love is shown by care.

4. C — Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   It is a substitute in some cases.

5. B — Providing food, clothing and shelter
   Basic needs.

6. A — Calmness in each position
   Staying still for a moment.

7. C — 6
   An-Naas has six verses.

8. C — They can protect you
   Adults can help.

9. A — Fajr
   Fajr has two.

10. D — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' is the All-Hearing.

11. C — The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   Ar-Rahman shows Allah's mercy to all creation.

12. C — Belief in Allah's angels
   It is the second pillar of Iman.

13. D — Grandmother
   Bibi means grandmother.

14. D — Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall
   Routine builds habits.

15. A — To worship Him and carry out His orders
   Allah does not need them.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is Allah's command, it brings love, unity and support, brings blessing and is an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example a cow and a bird.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.
